title: bupleurum ranunculoides var. canalense
intro: Bupleurum ranunculoides var. canalense, commonly known as Chinese Thorny Bupleurum, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Thorny Bupleurum include regulating the immune system, reducing fever, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
